title: Enhancing Attention and Wellbeing Using Digital Therapeutics
official: Optimizing a Closed-loop Digital Meditation Intervention for Remediating Cognitive Decline and Reducing Stress in Older Adults
summary: The goals of the proposed research are to first determine the minimal and/or optimal dose of a digital intervention required for cognitive enhancement, and then to examine the impact of several potential moderators of treatment effects (i.e., cognitive decline, AD polygenic hazard score, cardiovascular risk, and race/ethnicity). This knowledge gained from his high-impact study with transform the field of cognitive interventions, paving the way for a precision medicine model for cognitive enhancing interventions that improve quality of life for older adults and individuals with cognitive deficits at risk of developing dementia.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 60+ years old (adult)
* English language fluency
* owning a smartphone or tablet

Exclusion Criteria:

* Under 60 years old (minor)
